title: Malmgren on Office of Naval Intelligence knowledge
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Malmgren on Office of Naval Intelligence knowledge, about 1960s-1970s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Harold Malgm kept emphasizing that the office of naval intelligence knew way more than meets the eye.
That's what Harold Malmgren always said. He said the the deepest, you know, kind of core was the ONI, Office of Naval Intelligence. They really knew the most about this stuff.
tellings.difference: Calls ONI 'the deepest core' that knew the most, a stronger wording.
tellings.link_reason: Malmgren saying the Office of Naval Intelligence knew the most, relayed by Jesse Michels, is the same claim as the existing story.

as_told.title: Harold Malmgren: ONI knew the most

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that Harold Malmgren, described as a former presidential advisor, kept stressing one thing about the 1960s and 1970s: the Office of Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's intelligence service, knew far more about UFOs than it let on. In a later episode Michels puts it more strongly, saying Malmgren called it the deepest core of the secret, the group that knew the most. If true, it would point to the Navy as the place where the real knowledge sits.
